description: This file defines a class 'CodingStandardCommands' in the namespace SuiteCRM\Robo\Plugin\Commands. The class provides commands to automate PHP coding standards fixes and linting using PHP-CS-Fixer, including fixing all issues, dry run, and fixing only modified files. It inherits from Robo\Tasks and uses traits for additional functionality.

classes.name: CodingStandardCommands
classes.description: A commands class extending Robo Tasks for fixing PHP coding standards using PHP-CS-Fixer.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixer
methods.description: Runs PHP-CS-Fixer to automatically fix all PHP coding standards issues in the project.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerDryRun
methods.description: Performs a dry run of PHP-CS-Fixer to check for issues without modifying files.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerModified
methods.description: Fixes coding standards issues only in modified files that are staged or unstaged, based on git diffs.
